The only function on Enzyme v4 (Sulu) Polygon that a stranger can call and get paid for is the NAV round trip buyShares + redeemSharesForSpecificAssets on a fund's ComptrollerProxy: a stranger pays the denomination asset, receives shares at Chainlink NAV, and redeems for a specific non-denomination asset that trades on a DEX above that oracle price, pocketing the gap. The reward pot is the vault's balance of that mispriced asset, and it is empty on Polygon: the prior exhaustive scan (attempts:2529, 2026-11-19, all 1,924 NewFundCreated funds to block 97,593,463) found the best open (zero-timelock, no deposit-allowlist) vault holds only ~150 USD of a liquid non-denomination asset ('Genesis Capital Polygon' WETH 0.0742 + WBTC 0.0003), where a 0.1 pct oracle gap is worth ~0.15 USD once, and no other open vault holds a DEX-liquid asset worth taking.
